purpose: Versioned source register for research baselines in cloth simulation, robotic garment manipulation, textile sorting and sewing. This manifest does not declare any dataset ingested or authorize redistribution. This revision adds OpenTextile-NIR, two inverse-design research comparators, a design-sorting mismatch study and a 2026 critical fabric-design review. Reported percentages/metrics are source-specific and must not be treated as universal or reproduced Luminous results. This revision adds apparel scheduling comparators spanning dual-resource MIP/CP/heuristics, textile steam-aware multi-objective RL, source-load coordination, multi-line flow shops and human-centered scheduling. Published case results are scope-specific and are not a common leaderboard. This revision adds ASTM D6673-10 pattern interchange, the Knitout v0.6 machine-independent knitting instruction format and an open parametric sweater reference generator. These formats cover different layers and must not be conflated as a complete garment digital thread.

split_policy: never split repeated spectra or frames from the same physical specimen/garment across train and held-out evaluation
hold out complete garment identities and, where available, material families and source lots

cross_dataset_rule: TexSortML visual garment-family labels are not fibre-composition labels. NIR-SORT composition observations are not garment-category labels. Fusion is permitted only with matched item identity, independent measurement provenance and explicit missing/unknown states.
